# Rumored Imports This guide will explain how rumored imports play a key role in the economy and are crucial opportunities that allow characters to obtain the most exclusive devices and equipment which can be resold or utilized.
Information about imports currently available to your character is accessed through the 'Imports' tab of the Rumors section of the [bold]Job Network Menu[/bold].
## Delivery
Each rumored import will [bold]tell you which Trade Station it will be delivered to[/bold] before you purchase it. You do not need to be near the trade station to make this purchase.
The item is delivered in a crate which is locked specifically to you.
## Reputations
Your reputation with each Nation determines which imports will be available for you. Reputation is earned by completing rumors. As you earn reputation with a Nation your title will increase, unlocking more imports and better rumors.
Information about your current reputation and title with the Nations is available through the 'Reputations' tab of the Rumors section of the [bold]Job Network Menu[/bold].
## Exclusive Devices Some devices which are crucial to the economy such as Upgrade Modules, Trade Nodes and Codex Fragments are exclusive to the Rumored Imports.
The limited availability of these items mean they have extreme resale value as they are crucial for character or faction progression.
### Upgrade Modules Each Nation offers an exclusive variant of these. These devices can be applied to a wide variety of items and machines. For more information see the 'Upgrades' guidepage.
### Trade Nodes Trade Stations must stockpile Trade Nodes to upgrade their Infrastructure level which leads to more profitable bounties. Trade stations generate 10 Resonance per stored Trade Node every time bounties refresh. For more information see the 'Trade Station/Resonance' guidepage.
Trade Nodes can be exported for more than they cost to import, but the factions which control Trade Stations may purchase these at an even higher price.
### Codex Fragments Each Nation offers an exclusive variant of these. Using these will unlock 1 of 5 codex entries for the related Nation. Every five codex entries that a character unlock will grant them an Insight Perk choice. These Insights are incredibly powerful and so Codex Fragments are key for all characters progression. For more information see the 'Insights/Codex' guidepage
Codex Fragments are consumed on use and so trade demand for Fragments is always high.
## Exclusive Equipment As your title increases the Nations will offer increasingly powerful equipment that is exclusive to the Rumored Imports.
